title: Checkout latency regression
goal: Decide how to fix the slow checkout before Thursday's release

chunks.title: Checkout got 3x slower on Monday
chunks.purpose: Pin down what changed before looking at why.
chunks.mainPoint: p95 latency for `POST /checkout` jumped from about 180 ms to 640 ms with Monday's deploy, and it grows with cart size.
keyPoints: Only checkout is affected; every other endpoint is flat.
Carts with one item are as fast as before.
Database CPU rose 22% over the same period.
remember: The regression scales with the number of items in the cart.

chunks.title: The cause is one query per cart item
chunks.purpose: The fix depends on where the extra time goes.
chunks.mainPoint: Monday's price-rules change made the cart serializer load each item's price rule separately, so a 12-item cart now runs 14 queries instead of 2.
keyPoints: Each lookup takes about 35 ms, and they run one after another.
Nothing is wrong with the query itself; it is just run once per item.
chunks.details:
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant API as Checkout API
  participant DB as Postgres
  API->>DB: load cart
  API->>DB: load line items
  loop for each line item
    API->>DB: load price rule
  end
  API-->>API: serialize response
```

| Cart size | Queries before | Queries now | p95 now |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 item | 2 | 3 | 190 ms |
| 5 items | 2 | 7 | 350 ms |
| 12 items | 2 | 14 | 640 ms |
remember: Query count is 2 + one per line item.

chunks.title: Three ways to fix it
chunks.purpose: Each one removes the extra queries; they differ in risk and reach.
chunks.mainPoint: Loading every price rule in one query is the smallest change that brings checkout back to two round trips.
chunks.details:
| Fix | Queries per checkout | Files touched | Risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| Load price rules in one query | 3 | 1 | Low |
| Cache price rules in Redis | 2, once warm | 4 | Stale prices |
| Copy the price onto each line item | 2 | 9 + migration | Schema change |

questions.question: Which fix should I implement?
questions.context: The release freeze starts Thursday, so whatever ships has to be reviewed by Wednesday night.

options.label: Load price rules in one query
options.description: Fetch every rule for the cart up front and look them up in memory.
tradeoffs: One-file change, easy to review before the freeze
Still one extra query per checkout

options.label: Cache price rules in Redis
options.description: Keep rules in Redis and invalidate them when a rule is edited.
tradeoffs: A missed invalidation charges a stale price

options.label: Copy the price onto each line item
options.description: Store the resolved price when an item is added to the cart.
tradeoffs: Needs a migration and a backfill of open carts

questions.question: Is there anything in the checkout path I should leave alone?

keyContext: The average cart has 5 items; the largest this week had 41.
Price rules change a few times a day.
tray.runningSummary: Checkout is slow because of one extra query per cart item, introduced Monday. Three fixes are on the table.
